text:
Riley (Acme Health): Hey team, security wants specifics for the POC: what audit logs are available for hosted API keys vs Dedicated vs Private, retention to 365d, ability to forward to Splunk HEC over TLS, and proof we don’t expose prompt text by default. Need answers and a sample redacted log.

Maya (sales): Thanks Riley. We'll do Hosted or Dedicated POC. Quick check: do you want outbound IP allowlisting or just token+TLS to HEC? Also we'll bundle SOC2 summary + redacted logs once NDA is in place.

Riley (Acme Health): Token+TLS preferred. We can add allowlist later if needed. NDA is already signed for this POC.

Nora (eng): From engineering side:
- Hosted API: default audit entries include api_key_id, tenant_id, model, tokens_in/out, latency_ms, and a request_hash. Default retention 90d; POC enterprise can be extended to 365d. We do NOT include plaintext request_body/response_text in standard logs unless customer opts into full-capture.
- Dedicated pool: same structured logs, plus we can stream logs directly to your Splunk HEC or export to your S3 (encrypted with your CMK).
- Private/VPC: logs can be kept entirely in your VPC and integrated with your KMS/HSM.

For Splunk HEC forwarding we support HTTPS posts to the HEC collector. Need: endpoint URL, HEC token (we store encrypted), and optional IP allowlist. We can provide an outbound IP range for allowlisting. We'll also provide a small Docker forwarder if you want to host it.

Sam (security): Additions:
- Keys: Redwood-stored API keys are encrypted; Redwood staff do not have plaintext key access. Key rotation supported; recommend ~90 days for long-lived keys.
- Encryption: For Dedicated exports we support customer-managed KMS (AWS CMK). For Private, integrate with your KMS/HSM and keep logs in your account.
- Artifacts: we can share SOC2 Type II summary, control matrix, and redacted sample logs under existing NDA. Raw, full audit bundles require a security intake and limited-time S3 delivery with your CMK.

InfraBot: deploy-trigger: forwarding-agent-config created for tenant acme-tenant-02, forwarder_id ff-07

Riley (Acme Health): Can you paste a sample redacted log so our security team can sign off on the schema? Also call out any fields that may contain PII if full-capture is enabled.

Nora (eng): Sample redacted audit event:
{
  "timestamp":"2026-07-10T14:05:12Z",
  "tenant_id":"acme-tenant-02",
  "api_key_id":"ak-REDACTED",
  "request_hash":"sha256:9b2f...",
  "model":"redwood-extended-13b",
  "tokens_in":12,
  "tokens_out":48,
  "latency_ms":95,
  "outcome":"success",
  "forwarded_to":"splunk",
  "note":"prompt_redacted"
}

Fields that may contain customer data if full capture is enabled: request_body, response_text, attachments. Those fields are excluded by default.

Sam (security): We'll also provide a short write-up describing handling of sensitive fields, opt-in procedure for full capture (SOW + explicit approval), and procedures for delivering raw bundles to your S3 with CMK encryption and access logs.

Maya (sales): Action plan: 1) I'll attach the POC onboarding checklist + SOW for 365d audit retention and Splunk forwarding; 2) Nora will share the forwarder config and sample Docker image; 3) Sam will attach SOC2 summary and control mapping. Expect an email within 3 hours. Pricing note: small Dedicated 2-week POC estimate $5.8k (baseline + export).

Riley (Acme Health): Great, please include the outbound IP ranges in the email in case we need allowlisting later. We'll send the HEC endpoint and token via secure transfer once we have the forwarder config. Thanks all.

Maya (sales): Will do.
